ValidationRule.description: Story Verification Gate: blocks Ready to Promote while a verification is running.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Verification_Gate), AND(copado__Promote_Change__c = TRUE, OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(copado__Promote_Change__c))), ISPICKVAL(Verification_Status__c, "Running") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Verification is in progress. Promote is available once verification completes with a Clean result.
